$comment: DRAFT input contract for the aigdbench Task. Replaces the unvalidated TESTCASE/DRIVER/HARNESS_CMD/TIMEOUT env vars from docker/entrypoint.sh with a schema-checked business contract.
title: aigdbench task input

testcase.description: Testcase id, e.g. pathfinding-npc-bridge-astar (was $TESTCASE). See `aigdbench list`.

harness_cmd.description: Real AI harness command template, required only when driver=command (was $HARNESS_CMD). {task} is substituted with the task prompt.

testcases_dir.description: Testcase corpus root inside the image / shared storage (was $TESTCASES_DIR). Defaults to the baked-in set; point at /shared/testcases for the prewarmed shared corpus.

engine.description: Which Godot engine to use, once beaver-godot ships the second one (showcase PR #1158). Selects the --godot-binary.

timeout_seconds.description: Per-testcase harness budget (was $TIMEOUT). The Task-level spec.timeout still hard-caps this.
